# Synthetic QuatOps-style example (invented values)

This positive test fixture is synthetic; these values are invented to exercise
candidate detection and are not QuatOps benchmark results.

The benchmark comparison measured the scalar path at 0.42 µs and the array path
at 0.13 µs per operation; the latter was 3.2x faster in this run. Results used
Python 3.12.1 and NumPy 2.1.3 on the development workstation.
